ms.report:
Repository: https://github.com/TrustLevel/ZK-Defi-Protocol ('main')
On-chain zk-SNARK (Groth16 / BLS12-381) verification is implemented and proven live on Cardano Preprod: a full deposit → borrow → repay → unlock cycle where each borrow, repay and unlock is authorized by a Groth16 proof verified inside the Aiken validator, without revealing the prover's secret witness to the chain.

A. Output: zk-SNARK-based proof generation for each protocol component — collateral verification, loan initiation, and repayments.
Acceptance criteria: zk-SNARK proofs allow for private verification of collateral and loan transactions (the secret witness is never revealed to the chain).
Evidence:
・Circuit: https://github.com/TrustLevel/ZK-Defi-Protocol/blob/main/circuits/collateral_proof.circom
・Off-chain proof generation (borrow / repay / unlock): https://github.com/TrustLevel/ZK-Defi-Protocol/tree/main/offchain/cli/v5
・Live Preprod txs, proof verified on-chain (valid_contract: true): Borrow https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/19d9016ad95c3c410e8d66ce469a3f5e4cf2b329380555993fa1028110bb2b37 · Repay https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/8b934c059ab1d352f47277181bb871875907dd34c5506b1e75ac7a8e44a76cf6 · Unlock https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/24281542de3ab7e71e5a683917bd053d5a698ae2dfbf8daac0cf2346771ed609

B. Output: Functional zk-SNARK proof-generation library for use in private lending and borrowing transactions.
Acceptance criteria: The zk-SNARK library allows private lending and borrowing transactions (full deposit → borrow → repay → unlock cycle).
Evidence:
・Groth16 / BLS12-381 library — circom circuit + committed keys + Poseidon255, with on-chain verification via modulo-p/ak-381: https://github.com/TrustLevel/ZK-Defi-Protocol/tree/main/circuits and https://github.com/TrustLevel/ZK-Defi-Protocol/blob/main/contracts/lib/zk.ak
・Turnkey from a fresh clone: cd circuits && npm install && npm test → 9/9 passing (https://github.com/TrustLevel/ZK-Defi-Protocol/blob/mai
